label: First Way reception controls and adopted-potency incompatibility (inference)
rule: General same-respect impossibility theorem and explicit finite reception/conservation/brute models
meaning: Controls show that, if adopted POTENCY_1 means unactualized capacity, R2 plus R1 and the selected-world esse actuality interface exclude all contingent beings there; they do NOT derive a philosophically warranted B4. A genuinely received esse in a receptive principle can coexist with actual existence; a contingent POTENCY_1-pure-act mover can be under an external conserved-source mechanism (and cannot also be first in being); an unreceived contingent first mover demonstrates R1 is additional explanatory content even when esse differs from essence. These are typed structural tests, not a proof of philosophical possibility.
